text:
marta: Quick sync — we want a fast microburst for next-week's credit push. Short goal: lift first-5-requests conversion by 15% and add 200 webinar signups. Ideas on creative hooks and routing?

sam: Love it. Two lanes: (A) credit-first CTA for new signups, (B) webinar-first CTA targeting trial users who opened docs. A/B test landing headline + prompt template incentive.

jin: For creative, small experiments work best: 1) 'Starter tokens — try 5 requests free' 2) 'Live demo + free tokens' 3) 'Prompt pack + tokens' — each with a distinct hero image (product screenshot, person at laptop, code snippet).

ara: Routing: use inbound signal to prefer webinar-first for accounts with >2 repo stars or existing API keys. New emails get credit-first. We can do a weighted rollout 70/30 for first 48h.

marta: Good. Metrics: first-5-requests CVR, 7-day retention (used >50 tokens), and webinar attend rate. Success criteria: +15% CVR OR 200 incremental active users.

sam: Quick copy variants (short):
- Variant A: "Try Redwood — 5 free requests to get started"
- Variant B: "Unlock 5 free requests + a live demo"
- Variant C: "Starter prompt packs + 5 tokens — instant results"
Put these into subject lines and hero headings.

jin: Creative notes: keep token count visible, show latency/cost copy small (e.g., "<100ms dev latency") so devs see performance hint. Use badges: "No credit card" and "Free prompt pack".

ara: Operational checklist:
- Landing variants deployed to /microburst-credits with query param ?burst=1
- Segment routing rules in Launchboard: new_signups -> credit-first, trial_openers -> webinar-first
- GTM: send 1 email, 2 social posts, 1 doc banner
- Track events: page_view, started_requests, webinar_reg, webinar_attend

launch-bot: Deploy scheduled: landing variants pushed to staging at 2024-07-22T09:00Z; experiment flag 'microburst_071' created.

marta: Timeline: creative assets by EOD Wed (assets: 3 hero images, 3 subject lines, 3 hero copy options, 2 prompt templates). Jin can you own images? Sam on copy + email. Ara on routing + tracking.

jin: I'll mock images today and upload to Figma link: https://figma.com/file/microburst-credits (placeholder). Will include 2x mobile crops.

sam: I'll draft the email and 3 subject lines, plus 2 social posts. Will share in thread by tomorrow morning.

ara: I'll add routing rules and ensure Launchboard metrics are wired. Quick sanity check: make sure we have debounce so same user doesn't get both CTAs within 24h.

marta: Quick experiment config (proposal):
- N: 20k impressions first 72h
- Split: 50/50 credit vs webinar for eligible segment; subject-line A/B within each lane
- Win criteria: statistically significant +15% CVR at p<0.05 OR 200 incremental active users
- Fallback: if latency spikes or error rate >1.5% rollback to baseline landing

sam: One more ask — add one prompt-template CTA for 'build a dev sandbox app' with 3 starter prompts. Should help retention.

jin: I'll include the prompt pack screenshot in hero C.

marta: Perfect. Final: asset drop + copies by tomorrow noon so we can QA before staging push. Tag me if blocked. :rocket:
